messages:
ben: heads up — eu-west1 provisioning errors jumped 7% in last 10m. GPU allocs failing on ~12 hosts.
ida: seeing the same — BMCs on those hosts report secureboot: OFF and bootflags flipped after the midnight microcode push.
deploy-bot: firmware-rollout-4123 applied to rack-eu1a (partial). rollback available: run /runbooks/fw-rollback.
carla: can you paste oobctl show for one affected host?
ben: here — ```oobctl show host-227
BMC FW: 3.2.1-mc9
BIOS: 6.1.0
secureboot: disabled
last_update: 2026-03-20T00:12Z
logs: sigverify fail x12
``` 
devon: microcode 6.1.0 includes updated sigverify policy; looks like BMCs are re-provisioning secure boot state when mismatch occurs.
emma: any SLA impact? Dashboard shows GPU capacity drop ~18% in eu-west1 for model-serving pools.
ida: yes, evictions on model-serving-prod-2 — failover to other regions increasing cost. Putting canary rollback on racks e3/e4.
carla: recommend immediate partial rollback of firmware-rollout-4123 to stop further flag flips. runbook: /runbooks/fw-rollback step 4 -> oobctl apply -r 4123 --racks=e3,e4
ben: started rollback on e3,e4 — will monitor. also opening an incident ticket: INC-2026-0319
deploy-bot: rollback job 4123-R1 queued for e3,e4
carla: after rollback, check nvram checksum and tpm status: `journalctl -u tpm2-*` and `nvramtool verify host-227`.
devon: going to add a guard to rollout job to verify secureboot bit parity before applying. Follow-up PR @devex for canary gating.
ben: thanks everyone. update in 10m or when rollback completes :thumbsup:
